verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a government business-registry service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web forms, fillable PDFs, and upload/fax/mail submission. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, and the online filing entry page uses an image CAPTCHA, so no documented programmatic API is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
